verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's developer-platform page explicitly states that DDoS protection and WAF are built into the network and run on every request from day one, which covers both protection by default and coverage of every request for Workers traffic. The support rests on a single marketing-level claim, with no detailed first-party docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth WAF/DDoS documentation specific to Workers routes (default rulesets, configuration, plan-tier limits), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default

citations.quote: DDoS protection, WAF, bot management, and Zero Trust controls are built into the network and run on every request from day one.
